comment: R1-T1-TASL-ENV cross-host check of the G.1b TASL-7 nodes (g1b_crosscheck.py), re-issued under R1-T1-DATA-MANIFEST: it binds the re-issued G.1b spec and reruns in full under a new run id; paper.commit is the parent of the commit that carries this spec in the launch chain (verify_launch_tasl).
rule: R1-T1-TASL-ENV: the G.1b nodes measured on TASL-7 also run their default parts on TASL-2; the metrics must be identical, else STOP and that node's G.1b is re-measured on TASL-2
